root_cause: The default SMOKE_WAIT_SECONDS in sample-app/scripts/smoke_test.py was changed from 3 to 90, which exceeds the Smoke Test stage's 1-minute timeout.
key_evidence: 'Waiting 90s for the service to become healthy...' followed by 'Cancelling nested steps due to timeout' at about 60s
correct_fix: Restore the default wait to 3 seconds in sample-app/scripts/smoke_test.py; the jump from 3 to 90 is the regression.
acceptable_fixes: Raise the Smoke Test stage timeout above 90 seconds, if the longer wait is genuinely intended
